mapper.sql: SELECT b.bld_id, b.emd_nm, IFNULL(rs.high_iso_cnt, 0) high_cnt , MAX(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM survey_record sr WHERE sr.plan_id = sp.plan_id AND sr.created_at < #{before})) checked FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id LEFT JOIN bld_resident_stat rs ON rs.bld_id = b.bld_id WHERE sl.user_id = #{userId} AND b.sgg_cd = #{gu} GROUP BY b.bld_id, b.emd_nm, rs.high_iso_cnt
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(x.high_cnt), 0) total , IFNULL(SUM(IF(x.checked, x.high_cnt, 0)), 0) checked FROM () x WHERE x.high_cnt > 0

SELECT x.emd_nm, SUM(x.high_cnt) total, SUM(IF(x.checked, x.high_cnt, 0)) checked FROM () x WHERE x.high_cnt > 0 GROUP BY x.emd_nm ORDER BY SUM(x.high_cnt) - SUM(IF(x.checked, x.high_cnt, 0)) DESC, x.emd_nm

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(x.first_at, '%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) checked FROM (SELECT sp.plan_id, MIN(sr.created_at) first_at FROM survey_record sr JOIN survey_plan sp ON sp.plan_id = sr.plan_id JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE sl.user_id = #{userId} AND b.sgg_cd = #{gu} GROUP BY sp.plan_id) x WHERE x.first_at >= #{from} AND x.first_at < #{to} GROUP BY ym
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_report (user_id, sgg_cd, ym, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gu}, #{ym}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, ym, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%m.%d') created_at FROM monthly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sgg_cd = #{gu}AND sgg_cd IS NULL ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT report_id, ym, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at, status, sgg_cd FROM monthly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_report SET content = #{content}, status = #{status} WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM monthly_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM survey_record r0 JOIN visit_history v0 ON v0.visit_id = r0.visit_id WHERE r0.plan_id = sp.plan_id AND v0.visited_at < s.sched_date)
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) total, IFNULL(SUM(s.sched_date <= #{today}), 0) done
AND s.sched_date >= #{from} AND s.sched_date < #{to}

SELECT s.schedule_id, sp.plan_id, b.bld_id , DATE_FORMAT(s.sched_date, '%Y-%m-%d') sched_date , sp.visit_order , TRIM(CONCAT(IF(LOCATE('구 ', b.addr) > 0, SUBSTRING(b.addr, LOCATE('구 ', b.addr) + 2), b.addr), ' ', IFNULL(b.bld_nm, IFNULL(b.use_nm, '')))) title , IF(, 'REVISIT', 'VISIT') sched_type , sl.title memo , (SELECT v.result FROM survey_record r JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE r.plan_id = sp.plan_id AND v.visited_at >= s.sched_date ORDER BY v.visited_at DESC, r.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) check_result FROM survey_schedule s JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = s.survey_id JOIN survey_plan sp ON sp.survey_id = s.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.sched_date = #{date} ORDER BY sl.title, s.schedule_id, sp.visit_order IS NULL, sp.visit_order, sp.plan_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO recent_view (user_id, menu, url, title, sub, viewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{menu}, #{url}, #{title}, #{sub}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE url = #{url}, title = #{title}, sub = #{sub}, viewed_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id, r.menu, r.url, r.title, r.sub, DATE_FORMAT(r.viewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') viewed_at FROM recent_view r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.viewed_at DESC, r.menu LIMIT 3
